scripts.chat:on: wrangler d1 execute mugiwara-chat --remote -c wrangler.local.toml --command "UPDATE meta SET value = 0 WHERE key = 'mode'"
scripts.chat:readonly: wrangler d1 execute mugiwara-chat --remote -c wrangler.local.toml --command "UPDATE meta SET value = 1 WHERE key = 'mode'"
scripts.chat:off: wrangler d1 execute mugiwara-chat --remote -c wrangler.local.toml --command "UPDATE meta SET value = 2 WHERE key = 'mode'"
